# MoneyDrive

> South Africa's first AI-powered income expansion system for Uber and Bolt drivers. Your car. Your data. Your empire.

## Overview

MoneyDrive transforms gig economy driving from a survival grind into a scalable, multi-revenue business. Built specifically for South African Uber and Bolt drivers in Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, and Pretoria.

The platform provides three core income streams:
- **Smart Scheduling**: AI-powered route optimization based on South African event data, traffic patterns, and demand forecasting
- **Induna AI Broker**: On-chain agent that hunts corporate vehicle wrap deals and pitches your car's advertising value to brands like MTN, FNB, and Vodacom
- **In-Car Retail**: QR-based passenger commerce system for water, snacks, WiFi, and impulse purchases

## Key Capabilities

- **GPS-verified trip tracking** with real-time earnings calculations
- **Fuel cost intelligence** tracking profit per kilometre against rising fuel prices
- **Event-based hotspot routing** using SA concert, rugby match, and corporate event data
- **Voice AI hands-free control** — manage inventory and earnings without looking away from the road
- **Blockchain data ownership** via Internet Computer (ICP) — your route history and earnings data stored on-chain, impossible to deplatform

## Pricing Tiers

| Tier | Monthly | Features |
|------|---------|----------|
| **Hustler** | R350 | Basic dashboard, trip logging, fuel calculator, expense tracking, basic event alerts |
| **Pro Driver** | R530 | Everything in Hustler + smart scheduling, surge prediction, in-car QR retail, voice AI inventory |
| **Elite** | R800 | Everything in Pro + Induna AI deal broker, corporate wrap pitches, WhatsApp negotiation engine, full blockchain ownership |

## Target Users

- Uber and Bolt drivers in South Africa
- Fleet operators managing multiple vehicles
- Gig economy drivers seeking income diversification
- Professional drivers in Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: React + Tailwind CSS + Vite
- **Backend**: Internet Computer Protocol (ICP) — Motoko canisters
- **Data Storage**: ICP stable memory + blockchain ledger
- **APIs**: Google Maps (routing), South African event feeds
- **Voice AI**: Browser-based speech recognition + synthesis
- **Payment**: SnapScan (ZA), with plans for Yoco and PayFast integration

## Brand Voice

Direct, empowering, hustle-focused. No corporate speak. Built by South Africans who understand load shedding, potholes, and the daily reality of gig driving. We acknowledge the squeeze — then provide tools to fight back.
